name: 迷你立式静音净化器款
description: 迷你立式净化器套图：森绿首屏、静音夜护、滤网微距、功能图谱与信任收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: matte sage green wall #8FA795 for mood scenes, clean white #FFFFFF for info screens, deep night blue #1C2733 for quiet night scenes, charcoal #2B2B2B detail-module ground carrying rounded light-grey #F2F3F2 cards
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio light with front-left key and soft contact shadows; night scenes use low-key warm-dim bedside glow with one soft cool rim; no harsh speculars on plastic housings
styleLock.surfaceSystem: light oak wood floor #D9B98F, matte white tabletop, soft white bedding textiles #F7F5F2
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label typesetting, charcoal #2D2D2D on light grounds and #FFFFFF on dark grounds
styleLock.iconSystem: thin solid line icons with small mint #9BD4B8 accent fills, one icon per label
styleLock.presentationRules: product upright and centered-stable, consistent slight 3/4 hero angle for packshot-style screens, true-to-life scale, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh green clean-air appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, sage green #8FA795, deep night blue #1C2733, one mint accent #9BD4B8 and charcoal text #2D2D2D kept for typography on light grounds; bright soft diffused studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows, low-key dim glow for night scenes; modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label typesetting; consistent thin-line icons with small mint accent fills; rounded light-grey info cards on charcoal for detail modules; upright stable product presentation at true-life scale, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏承接点击，用森绿植物与清新空气氛围一秒传递洁净主张
shots.camera: 平视正面机位，机身直立立于木地板、背靠墙面，正对镜头
shots.lighting: 右侧柔和漫射日光如纱帘透光，叶影轻落，软接触阴影
shots.background: 哑光鼠尾草绿墙 #8FA795 + 浅橡木地板 #D9B98F + 白色踢脚线
shots.props: 左下角一盆白盆绿叶植物，不遮挡产品
shots.textZone: 画面上三分之一区域：居中一枚深绿 #2F6B55 圆角胶囊标签「{selling_point_1}」+ 一行白色标题「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce scene hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level straight-on view: the upright unit stands on a light oak wood floor #D9B98F against a matte sage green wall #8FA795 with a white baseboard, and one leafy potted plant in a white ribbed pot sits at the lower corner, never covering the product. Soft diffused daylight from the right like light through a sheer curtain, gentle leaf shadows, a soft contact shadow grounding the unit. The upper third of the frame carries one rounded deep-green #2F6B55 pill badge with 「{selling_point_1}」 and one white headline line 「{callout_1}」, so the product and the label band together compose one complete balanced layout with the product filling 40-50% of the frame. 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand marks or logos, no people, no dense body text, no watermark, no cluttered props, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 合规白底过审，一秒说清核心净化卖点，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: 正面微 3/4 机位，机身直立居中偏右，全身入画不被裁切
shots.lighting: 明亮均匀高调棚光，左前主光加补光，软接触阴影
shots.textZone: 画面左侧区域：一行深灰 #2D2D2D 短标题「{callout_1}」+ 一枚 #9BD4B8 细线图标
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 hero angle: the upright unit stands centered-right on a seamless pure white #FFFFFF ground, full product visible and unclipped, filling 50-60% of the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key and fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the unit. The left side of the frame carries one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D and one thin-line icon with a #9BD4B8 accent, so the product and the text block together compose one complete balanced layout. 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no more than one claim, no dense body text, no invented performance numbers, no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 放大粉尘花粉困扰，左右对比让用户对号入座产生痛感
shots.camera: 左右分屏对称机位，两栏相机高度、角度与裁切完全一致
shots.lighting: 左栏灰暗平板光显沉闷，右栏柔和明亮洁净光
shots.background: 两栏同一浅色客厅墙面 #EFEFEA，仅光线与颗粒状态不同
shots.textZone: 每栏底部一条干净说明条，各一行短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen of {product}, two matched panels with identical camera height, angle and crop. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: a plain living-room wall #EFEFEA seen through hazy dull flat light with small drifting dust and pollen particles drawn as tiny grey-mint dots, no person. Right panel: the same room rendered clear and bright with {product} standing against the wall and filling 40-50% of that panel, soft clean light and a gentle contact shadow. Each panel carries a clean caption strip along its bottom with one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D, the two panels reading as one complete balanced composition. Negative: no fabricated statistics or percentages, no disgusting or scary imagery, no people, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以大数字对比位呈现本机与传统机型的安静差异，数值由使用方回填不编造
shots.camera: 微抬高 15° 的正面信息图机位，产品置于画面下三分之一
shots.lighting: 低key暗场，机身一粒柔和呼吸指示微光，数字区域干净无杂光
shots.textZone: 上半部暗场：两枚薄荷绿 #9BD4B8 大数字「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」以细竖线 #46546A 分隔，各配一行灰蓝 #B9C2CC 短说明
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce numeric comparison infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slightly elevated straight-on infographic view on a deep night blue #1C2733 ground: the unit stands on a bedside surface in the lower third with one soft dim indicator glow, filling 30-40% of the frame, and above it two oversized numbers in mint #9BD4B8 read 「{callout_1}」 for {product} and 「{callout_2}」 for a conventional unit, separated by a thin vertical divider #46546A, each with one short grey-blue #B9C2CC label line, the numbers and the unit composing one complete balanced dark-scene layout. Negative: do NOT invent any numeric values, percentages or test data, all figures come from the supplied text slots; no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no clutter.

shots.intent: 卧室夜灯场景引导代入，暗示整夜安静守护不扰眠
shots.camera: 床头侧 3/4 平视机位，纪实手持感
shots.lighting: 左侧 3000K 暖暗床头灯光为主，机身一道柔和冷色轮廓光，深而安静的长影
shots.background: 深夜蓝炭色墙面 #1C2733 + 柔白床品 #F7F5F2
shots.props: 低床头柜一角，仅保留必要织物，不遮挡产品
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle night scene of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A 3/4 eye-level bedside view with a candid documentary feel: the unit stands on a low nightstand beside a bed where a person sleeps under a soft duvet, seen from behind with no recognizable face. Low-key warm-dim bedside glow around 3000K from the left and one soft cool rim light on the product, deep quiet shadows, a faint dim indicator on the unit. Deep navy-charcoal walls #1C2733 and soft white bedding #F7F5F2. The product is the clear anchor filling 40-50% of the frame, surrounded by natural breathing margins that keep the night mood quiet. Negative: no recognizable face, no harsh flash, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered nightstand.

shots.intent: 滤网分层微距证明净化机制真实可见，建立结构信任
shots.camera: 45° 侧向微距机位，浅景深，前层滤网锐利、后层渐虚
shots.lighting: 左侧掠射侧光揭示网面与褶边纹理，一处可控高光
shots.background: 炭黑 #2B2B2B 底上悬浮一张圆角浅灰 #F2F3F2 卡片
shots.whitespace: minimal（细节即主体，卡片保留自然边距）
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the filter assembly of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A 45-degree side macro view of the exploded filter structure: a coarse mesh pre-layer and pleated media layers fanned apart, the foreground layer razor sharp with shallow depth of field. Raking side light from the left reveals the mesh texture and pleated edges with one controlled highlight. The macro sits inside a rounded light-grey #F2F3F2 card floating on a charcoal #2B2B2B ground. The detail fills 55-60% of the card with only the card's natural margins around it, because the detail is the whole point, and one small label 「{callout_1}」 sits at the card bottom in #2D2D2D. 4K texture rendering. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented filter life numbers or certifications, no duplicated parts, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 六宫格集中讲清智能功能点，配放大特写位降低理解成本
shots.camera: 正面平铺信息图机位，产品顶部居中呈微 3/4 角，配一枚圆形放大特写位
shots.lighting: 均匀高调平光，无戏剧性投影
shots.background: 纯白 #FFFFFF 版面，卡片浅灰 #F2F3F2
shots.props: 六张圆角浅灰功能卡，各含一枚细线图标
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce feature grid infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat graphic layout on pure white #FFFFFF: the upright unit at top center shown at a slight 3/4 angle with one circular macro inset magnifying its display and sensor zone, and below it a 3x2 grid of six rounded light-grey #F2F3F2 cards, each holding one thin-line icon with a #9BD4B8 accent fill and one short label in #2D2D2D reading 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. The product with its inset and the card grid together fill 50-60% of the frame with even gutters between cards, composing one complete balanced layout. Negative: no dense body text, no more than six cards, no invented feature claims or certifications, no real brand icons, no extra text beyond the six labels, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 一屏讲清尺寸与规格，消除放不放得下的疑虑
shots.camera: 高位 45° 俯视机位，尺寸标注线向外展开，下方接三栏规格表
shots.lighting: 均匀平光，清晰易读，无戏剧性投影
shots.props: 细尺寸标注线与两枚圆角数字徽标，三栏规格列表
shots.textZone: 两枚圆角数字徽标「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」+ 三栏规格字段「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. High 45-degree angle looking down at the upright unit standing on a seamless white #FFFFFF surface, filling 60-70% of the frame, with thin #9AA3AD dimension lines and end ticks pointing to two rounded number badges 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, and below a three-column spec list with short field labels 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 in #2D2D2D, the diagram and the spec list composing one complete balanced layout. Even flat readable lighting, no dramatic shadow. Negative: no fabricated measurements or model codes, no unreadable tiny text, no dense spec tables, no extra text beyond the listed labels, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 家庭画面配合看得见的静音运行细节降低购买风险，情感与安心双收
shots.camera: 床尾平视 3/4 生活机位，人物软焦、产品清晰
shots.lighting: 左侧 5000K 柔暖窗光，通透高调，轻接触阴影
shots.background: 柔白床品 #F7F5F2 + 浅木床头板 #D9B98F
shots.props: 机身一粒柔和的运行指示微光，无任何认证图形
shots.textZone: 上方区域：一枚薄荷绿 #9BD4B8 细线盾形图标 + 两行短信任标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce family trust scene for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level 3/4 lifestyle view from the foot of a bed: a parent and a child sit together on soft white bedding #F7F5F2 with a light wood headboard #D9B98F, both partly turned away and softly out of focus so no face is recognizable, while {product} stands sharp on a low bedside surface with its dim indicator glow softly visible. Soft warm window daylight from the left around 5000K, airy high-key feel, gentle contact shadow. The upper area of the frame carries one mint #9BD4B8 thin-line shield icon with two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D, and the product fills 40-50% of the frame as the sharp anchor of one complete balanced composition. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data, no certification artwork of any kind; no recognizable faces, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 英雄式收口加行动按钮促单，按钮与利益文案由使用方回填
shots.camera: 低角度仰视机位，产品居中英雄式呈现，稳定不倾
shots.lighting: 左前柔和主光加顶缘轮廓光，软接触阴影，比全组略提神
shots.background: 平涂鼠尾草绿 #8FA795 无缝棚景
shots.props: 一枚大圆角 CTA 按钮（深绿 #2F6B55）
shots.textZone: 顶部居中一行白色短标题「{callout_1}」；右下一枚大圆角 CTA 按钮（深绿 #2F6B55）配白色按钮字「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Low angle looking slightly upward at the upright unit centered on a flat sage green #8FA795 studio sweep, heroic and stable, filling 60-70% of the frame, with a soft front-left key light, a rim light along the top edge and a soft contact shadow. One short white headline 「{callout_1}」 sits at the top center, and at the lower right one large rounded CTA button in deep green #2F6B55 carries the white button label 「{callout_2}」, completing the closing composition. Negative: no invented discounts or countdowns, no fake logos, no extra text, no hands, no watermark, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 从 9 屏爆款空气净化器详情长图切片提炼；已剥离原品牌徽标、机型代号、门店会员二维码及全部原文案，数据类文案（分贝、百分比、尺寸、型号）一律改为 {callout_n} 文案槽位由使用方回填真实内容，不保留任何数值；人物仅保留角色不保留面貌；源图细节卡与场景卡在切片中未含成品内容，滤网结构特写按品类通用视觉语法补全；产品一律以 {product} 占位。
